title: PH6 Cognitive Stratigraphy Layer v1
description: One chronological sediment layer in the cognitive stratigraphy model. Layer N = active state; Layer N-1 = prior; Layer N-2 = baseline.

continuity_hash.description: BLAKE2b-256 of this layer's canonical context.

recovered_nodes.description: Used in MCI denominator: assumptions / max(recovered_nodes, 1).

reasoning_fossil_signatures.description: BLAKE2b-256 hashes of preserved reasoning artifacts from this layer.

mci_score.description: Minimum-Capacity Inference score. Lower = fewer assumptions = stronger reconstruction.
